const results = $input.all().map((item) => item.json.data || {});
return [{ json: { data: { suggestion_type: 'seo_description', drafts_stored: results.filter((r) => r.created).length, already_queued: results.filter((r) => r.created === false).length, status: 'pending_review', note: 'Drafts await human review in the admin; nothing is published automatically.' } } }];
